test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person borrows Rs. 75,000 for 3 years at 7% simple interest. He lends it to B at 5% for 3 years. What is his loss (in Rs.)?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal borrowed for 3 years at 7% simple interest = Rs.75000 

Lending rate of the same principal for 3 years = 5% 

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate/100 × Time 

**Calculation:**

Simple interest payable = 75000 × 7/100 × 3 

⇒ Rs.15750 

Simple interest Receivable = 75000 × 5/100 × 3 

⇒ Rs.11250

∴ Loss incurred by the person = Interest payable - Interest receivable 

**⇒ Rs.15750 - 11250 = Rs.4500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Loss = 75000 × (7 - 5)% × 3 

⇒ 75000 × 2/100 × 3 

**⇒ Rs.4500 **
